content.title: The Boys season 5 release schedule: what time is episode 4 on Prime Video?
content.text: (Image credit: Prime Video) Well, well, well. If it isn't you diabolical lot again. No, we're not going all Butcher on you, don't worry. Instead, we're here to help you get ahead of the game as Prime Video's superhero show comes to a close, with The Boys season 5, episode 4 release date in the US and UK.Right now, we're fast approaching the midway point and it appears big deaths are on the table. Spoilers are all over social media too, so it pays to get prepped with the Prime Video streaming time for The Boys' latest efforts.Article continues below The Boys season 5, episode 4 release date: what time is on Prime Video? (Image credit: Prime Video)The Boys season 5, episode 4 releases on Prime Video on April 22 at midnight Pacific/3:00 AM Eastern.Across the pond in the UK, that's 8:00 AM BST.For what that means in your region, please use the time zone converter.The Boys season 5 release schedule: when are new episodes out? (Image credit: Prime Video)Unlike its anime cousins (looking at you, JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Steel Ball Run), The Boys season 5's endgame release plans have already been mapped out in full.First up, two episodes will be released on April 8, followed by an episode every week until May.The Boys season 5 release schedule is locked in and available below:The Boys season 5, episode 1: April 8, 2026 - out now!The Boys season 5, episode 2: April 8, 2026 - out now!The Boys season 5, episode 3: April 15, 2026 - out now!The Boys season 5, episode 4: April 22, 2026The Boys season 5, episode 5: April 29, 2026The Boys season 5, episode 6: May 6, 2026The Boys season 5, episode 7: May 13, 2026The Boys season 5, episode 8: May 20, 2026Where to watch The Boys season 5 (Image credit: Prime Video)As ever, The Boys is available exclusively to Amazon Prime subscribers through their Prime Video account.The Boys season 5 episode count and is this the final season? (Image credit: Prime Video)The Boys season 5 is listed for eight episodes, which officially brings the series to an end. Three episodes have aired so far.Eric Kripke recently revealed that Amazon wanted more than five seasons but ultimately left the narrative in a place during The Boys season 4 ending where it had to move into its final act. Checkmate, executives.For more, check out the best shows on Prime Video.
